# wellplayed_iam_group (Resource)

Manages an organization permission group: a named set of permissions that members and apps can be assigned to (see `wellplayed_iam_member`'s `group_id`). Backed by the `createOrganizationGroup`, `updateOrganizationGroup`, and `deleteOrganizationGroup` mutations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A permission group that tournament editors are assigned to.
resource "wellplayed_iam_group" "editors" {
  name = "Tournament Editors"

  permissions {
    id        = "tournament:write"
    resources = ["tournament_123", "tournament_456"]
  }

  permissions {
    id        = "tournament:read"
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

# Assign a member to the group above (see wellplayed_iam_member).
resource "wellplayed_iam_member" "editor" {
  email    = "teammate@example.com"
  group_id = wellplayed_iam_group.editors.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the group. Unique within the organization.

### Optional

- `permissions` (Attributes Set) Permissions granted to members of this group. Omit for a group with no permissions. Unlike `wellplayed_iam_member`, group permissions are returned by the API, so out-of-band changes are detected as drift. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the group was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the group.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization this group belongs to.
- `type` (String) The type of group, one of `ANONYMOUS`, `CONNECTED`, `MEMBER`, `ADMIN`. Assigned by the API.
- `updated_at` (String) When the group was last updated (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `id` (String) The permission identifier.
- `resources` (Set of String) Resource identifiers this permission is scoped to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# IAM groups are imported by their group ID.
terraform import wellplayed_iam_group.editors grp_01h...
```
